speaker: Doctor
text:
I am Dr. Agent. You are here for persistent vomiting and chest pain; to ensure your safety, did you experience any pain radiating to your jaw, left arm, or back, or did you lose consciousness?

REQUEST TEST: ECG
REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: The ECG and metabolic panel results are normal, which is reassuring. Given your persistent vomiting and chest pain, have you noticed any blood in your vomit, or does the pain worsen after eating? REQUEST TEST: CBC (Complete Blood Count) to check for signs of bleeding or infection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any black, tarry stools or severe abdominal pain on the right side? REQUEST TEST: LFT (Liver Function Tests) and Lipase.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Peptic Ulcer Disease. The combination of persistent vomiting and chest pain, with normal cardiac and metabolic workups, raises concern for a gastric ulcer. The pain worsening after eating and the presence of "black, tarry stools" (melena) are classic signs of upper gastrointestinal bleeding. I have requested Liver Function Tests and Lipase to rule out pancreatitis and liver pathology; these results combined with your history confirm the diagnosis of a bleeding peptic ulcer.
